The '''Chilling Death Spire''' was a massive ice spire carved by the [[Hailstorm Brotherhood]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the [[Glacial Fissure]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] at some point surrounding the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
